loop_end_convention: Manifest and helper use exclusive end; WAV smpl uses inclusive last sample.

custom_explosion.description: User-selected destruction sound for all Void Run explosions.

custom_powerup.description: User-selected pickup confirmation for Void Run powerups.

laser_light.description: Fast cyan laser: tight energy snap and short low-end body.

laser_powered.description: Power-up laser: thicker plasma attack and heavier tail.

spread_shot.description: One sound per spread-shot volley, not one sound per projectile.

missile_launch.description: Missile launcher: mechanical kick, ignition, and rocket rush.

missile_flight_loop.description: Quiet sustained rocket flight. Fade in/out; do not restart every frame.

missile_detonate.description: Missile impact with a sharp crack, bass punch, and debris.

beam_charge.description: Player beam charging, rising energy with accelerating pulses.

beam_start.description: Initial beam firing punch; transition into beam_sustain_loop.

beam_sustain_loop.description: Continuous player beam; seamless full-file loop, stop on release.

beam_stop.description: Beam release: energy power-down and airy discharge.

weapon_overheat.description: Overheat vent and descending weapon motor.

dry_fire.description: Short empty-ammunition or blocked-fire mechanical click.

drone_shot.description: Circular drone attack. One sound per firing event/volley.

dart_shot.description: Dart interceptor attack. One sound per firing event/volley.

spiker_shot.description: Spiked drone attack. One sound per firing event/volley.

crescent_shot.description: Crescent reaper attack. One sound per firing event/volley.

gunship_shot.description: Heavy gunship attack. One sound per firing event/volley.

elite_claw_fire.description: Elite claw sentinel heavy energy shot.

elite_siege_fire.description: Elite siege orb heavy energy shot.

elite_wraith_fire.description: Elite energy wraith heavy energy shot.

boss15_segment_servo.description: Serpent boss segment/jaw movement. Trigger sparingly, not every segment/frame.

boss15_beam_charge.description: Serpent mouth weapon charge and servos.

boss20_gravity_charge.description: Void-crown gravitational weapon telegraph; low accelerating charge.

boss20_void_beam_loop.description: Void-crown sustained beam. Fade in and out.

boss20_phase_change.description: Void-crown phase transition swell and reverse pull.

explosion_small.description: Small destruction: transient, pressure wave, debris, and fading tail. Play once, not once per animation frame.

explosion_medium.description: Medium destruction: transient, pressure wave, debris, and fading tail. Play once, not once per animation frame.

explosion_large.description: Large destruction: transient, pressure wave, debris, and fading tail. Play once, not once per animation frame.

explosion_player.description: Player destruction: transient, pressure wave, debris, and fading tail. Play once, not once per animation frame.

explosion_boss.description: Boss destruction: transient, pressure wave, debris, and fading tail. Play once, not once per animation frame.

hull_hit.description: Hull damage impact: dry metallic thud.

shield_hit.description: Shield hit: neon energy membrane effect.

shield_on.description: Shield on: neon energy membrane effect.

shield_off.description: Shield off: neon energy membrane effect.

shield_break.description: Shield break: neon energy membrane effect.

electric_arc.description: Electrical hit sparks and short-circuit arcing.

bullet_near_miss.description: Quick bullet fly-by; use only near player, with a cooldown.

engine_idle_loop.description: Continuous player engine idle. Crossfade rather than layering all engine states.

engine_thrust_loop.description: Continuous player engine thrust. Crossfade rather than layering all engine states.

engine_boost_loop.description: Continuous player engine boost. Crossfade rather than layering all engine states.

boost_stop.description: Player boost disengage and exhaust release.

bank_whoosh.description: Quick ship banking movement. Trigger only on meaningful bank changes.

smoke_vent.description: Damage smoke/vent hiss; subtle, not every particle.

debris_scatter.description: Loose hull debris clatter and diminishing fragments.

pickup_power.description: Power pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

pickup_shield.description: Shield pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

pickup_speed.description: Speed pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

pickup_weapon.description: Weapon pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

pickup_life.description: Life pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

pickup_health.description: Health pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

pickup_coin.description: Coin pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

pickup_time.description: Time pickup confirmation with its own short melodic identity.

low_health_loop.description: Low-health warning pulse; use only while danger condition persists.

arcade_hum_loop.description: Subtle arcade hum atmosphere. Optional, not a music track.

deep_space_loop.description: Subtle deep space atmosphere. Optional, not a music track.

boss_pressure_loop.description: Subtle boss pressure atmosphere. Optional, not a music track.

warp_tunnel_loop.description: Subtle warp tunnel atmosphere. Optional, not a music track.
